dialog.startupRecoveryFailed.title: ShowConfirmation caption at startup when journal reconcile marked interrupted operations Failed.
dialog.startupRecoveryFailed.message.one: ShowConfirmation text at startup; {count} = number of interrupted operations marked Failed. Yes opens the Recovery window.
dialog.exportActions.failed.title: MessageBox caption when Export of action profiles cannot write the file.
dialog.exportActions.failed.message: MessageBox text; {error} = the system error message (disk full, access denied, ...).
settings.nav.general: Settings window: left-navigation entry and matching page title for the General page.
settings.nav.display: Settings window: left-navigation entry and matching page title for the Display page.
settings.nav.mouse: Settings window: left-navigation entry and matching page title for the Mouse & zoom page.
settings.nav.performance: Settings window: left-navigation entry and matching page title for the Performance page.
settings.nav.shortcuts: Settings window: left-navigation entry and matching page title for the Shortcuts page.
settings.nav.files: Settings window: left-navigation entry and matching page title for the Files & safety page.
settings.nav.diagnostics: Settings window: left-navigation entry and matching page title for the Diagnostics page.
settings.nav.automationName: AutomationProperties.Name of the Settings window's left navigation list.
settings.instanceMode.label: Settings > General: label for the InstanceMode picker (one window vs. one window per folder).
settings.instanceMode.hint: Settings > General: help text under the instance mode picker; it only takes effect at the next launch.
settings.showInfoOverlay.label: Settings > Display: master switch for the on-image info overlays; mentions its shortcut (I) so the user can find it without opening the Shortcuts page.
settings.showFileInfo.label: Settings > Display: sub-option, shown under the master switch, for the bottom-left file info block.
settings.showFolderInfo.label: Settings > Display: sub-option, shown under the master switch, for the bottom-right folder info block.
settings.group.exif: Settings > Display: header of the (currently empty) EXIF section a later branch fills in.
settings.group.mouseZoom: Settings > Mouse & zoom: section header (also reused as the page title).
settings.mouseWheelAction.label: Settings > Mouse & zoom: label for the MouseWheelAction picker.
settings.mouseWheelAction.hint: Settings > Mouse & zoom: help text noting that Ctrl+wheel always zooms regardless of this setting.
settings.mouseWheelAction.automationName: AutomationProperties.Name of the MouseWheelAction combo box.
enum.mouseWheelAction.zoom: MouseWheelAction.Zoom combo box item: the plain wheel zooms the image.
enum.mouseWheelAction.navigate: MouseWheelAction.Navigate combo box item: the plain wheel moves to the next/previous image.
settings.clickToZoom.label: Settings > Mouse & zoom: checkbox enabling click-to-zoom.
settings.clickZoomPercent.label: Settings > Mouse & zoom: label for the click-zoom percent box (10-800), disabled when click-to-zoom is off.
settings.clickZoomPercent.automationName: AutomationProperties.Name of the click-zoom percent box.
settings.kineticPan.label: Settings > Mouse & zoom: checkbox enabling kinetic (inertial) panning after a drag.
settings.group.navigation: Settings > Shortcuts: group header over Next/Previous/First/Last image and folder navigation shortcuts.
settings.group.view: Settings > Shortcuts: group header over zoom/fit/fullscreen/info-overlay shortcuts.
settings.group.actions: Settings > Shortcuts: group header over skip/undo/compare/move/copy/recycle shortcuts.
settings.shortcut.lastImage: Settings > Shortcuts label: jump to the last image in the folder. Optional (may be cleared).
settings.shortcut.lastImage.clearAutomat: AutomationProperties.Name of the small clear (✕) button next to the Last image shortcut box.
settings.shortcut.zoomActualSize: Settings > Shortcuts label: zoom to 100% (one source pixel per device pixel). Optional (may be cleared).
settings.shortcut.zoomActualSize.clearAu: AutomationProperties.Name of the small clear (✕) button next to the Zoom 100% shortcut box.
settings.shortcut.toggleInfoOverlay: Settings > Shortcuts label: show/hide the on-image info overlays. Optional (may be cleared).
settings.shortcut.toggleInfoOverlay.clea: AutomationProperties.Name of the small clear (✕) button next to the Toggle info overlay shortcut box.
settings.shortcut.moveToFolder: Settings > Shortcuts label: "Move to..." (asks for a folder and moves the photo there). Optional (may be cleared). Keep the ellipsis, this shortcut opens a dialog.
settings.shortcut.moveToFolder.clearAuto: AutomationProperties.Name of the small clear (✕) button next to the Move to... shortcut box.
settings.shortcut.copyToFolder: Settings > Shortcuts label: "Copy to..." (asks for a folder and copies the photo there). Optional (may be cleared). Keep the ellipsis, this shortcut opens a dialog.
settings.shortcut.copyToFolder.clearAuto: AutomationProperties.Name of the small clear (✕) button next to the Copy to... shortcut box.
settings.moveCopyReuseLastFolder.label: Settings > Shortcuts: checkbox next to Move to/Copy to; when on, the shortcut reuses the last-used folder instead of asking.
settings.moveCopyReuseLastFolder.hint: Settings > Shortcuts: help text noting that holding Shift always shows the folder picker even when reuse is on.
settings.editActionProfiles: Settings > Shortcuts: button that opens the action profiles editor (ActionProfilesWindow) for the JSON on the Files & safety page.
settings.group.compareOptions: Settings > Files & safety: section header over the duplicate-detection options (compare by hash / by size).
dialog.settingsInvalid.clickZoomPercent: MessageBox text shown on Save when the click-zoom percent box is not a number in [{min}, {max}] (AppSettings.MinClickZoomPercent/MaxClickZoomPercent).
exif.dimensions: Photo information line (under the status line): original image size in pixels; {width}/{height} are plain numbers. Parts of the line are joined with " · ".
exif.iso: Photo information line: sensor sensitivity; {value} = ISO number (e.g. 400). "ISO" is normally kept as is.
exif.focalLength: Photo information line: lens focal length; {value} = millimetres (e.g. 50 or 18.5).
exif.aperture: Photo information line: aperture as an f-number; {value} = e.g. 2.8. "f/" is the photographic notation, normally kept.
exif.shutterFraction: Photo information line: short shutter speed as a fraction of a second; {denominator} = e.g. 250 (1/250 s). Keep it short.
exif.shutterSeconds: Photo information line: long shutter speed in seconds; {value} = e.g. 0.5 or 30. Keep it short.
main.exif.automationName: Screen-reader name of the photo information line; {details} = the line's text (file name, date, size, camera, lens, exposure).
settings.showExifInfo.label: Settings > Display, EXIF section: master switch for the photo information line; the fields below are disabled when this is off (and the whole overlay is hidden by ShowInfoOverlay, shortcut I).
settings.exifField.fileName: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.FileName.
settings.exifField.dateTaken: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.DateTaken.
settings.exifField.dimensions: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.Dimensions.
settings.exifField.camera: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.Camera.
settings.exifField.lens: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.Lens.
settings.exifField.iso: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.Iso.
settings.exifField.focalLength: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.FocalLength.
settings.exifField.aperture: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.Aperture.
settings.exifField.shutterSpeed: Settings > Display, EXIF section: per-field checkbox for ExifInfoFields.ShutterSpeed.
settings.group.exif.hint: Settings > Display, EXIF section: help text noting that the whole section is hidden whenever the ShowInfoOverlay master switch (shortcut I) is off.
err.decoder.memoryBuffer: Inserted as {source} of err.decoder.notJpeg when the JPEG came from memory, not from a file. Lowercase noun phrase.
err.decoder.notJpeg: Image error text shown after "Image error: <file> —" in the status bar. {source} = full file path, or the phrase for "memory buffer".
err.decoder.iccFallback: Explains why the fast JPEG decoder gave up. Normally not shown because the app falls back automatically. ICC = color profile standard, keep the abbreviation.
err.decoder.noDetail: Inserted as {detail} of the err.decoder.* keys when the native decoder library gave no error text. Lowercase phrase.
err.decoder.headerFailed: Image error text. {detail} = English error text from the native TurboJPEG library (not translatable) or the no-details phrase.
err.decoder.invalidDimensions: Image error text. {width} and {height} are pixel counts; keep the "x" between them.
err.decoder.decompressFailed: Image error text. {detail} = English error text from the native TurboJPEG library or the no-details phrase.
err.decoder.infoFailed: Image error text when reading image size/format only (no full decode). {detail} as in err.decoder.headerFailed.
err.decoder.noSource: Internal programming error that should never reach users; kept translatable for completeness.
err.decoder.outputTooLarge: Image error text for a huge photo. {width}/{height} in pixels, {bytes} = memory needed. Vietnamese has no plural form for "byte".
err.decoder.strictModeFailed: Image error text. Strict mode = reject damaged JPEG files instead of showing them partly. {detail} as in err.decoder.headerFailed.
err.decoder.iccTransformFailed: Image error text (WIC decoder). {detail} = message from Windows, already in the Windows display language. ICC and sRGB stay as is.
err.io.imageNotFound: Image error text; {path} = full file path.
err.io.sourceChangedDuringDecode: Image error text; another program modified or replaced the file. {path} = full file path.
err.io.sourceChangedReadingDimensions: Image error text; another program modified or replaced the file. {path} = full file path.
err.io.unexpectedEof: Image/duplicate-check error text; the file is shorter than expected (e.g. it was truncated while reading). {path} = full file path.
err.io.fileChangedWhileReading: Image/duplicate-check error text; another program modified the file. {path} = full file path.
err.io.sourceNoLongerExists: Image error text; the file was deleted or moved after it was listed. {path} = full file path.
err.io.fileChangedWhileHashing: Status text when a file hash (checksum used for duplicate detection and compare) is computed; another program modified the file meanwhile. {path} = full file path.
err.io.hashServiceMissing: Duplicate-check status text after "Duplicate check failed:". Internal setup error that should never reach users. "hash" = checksum of the file contents (keep as technical term).
unit.milliseconds: Diagnostics/Benchmark windows: a duration in milliseconds; {value} is an already formatted number.
unit.size.byte: File size below 1 KB (status bar, compare); {value} is a formatted number.
unit.size.kilobyte: File size in kilobytes (1024 bytes); {value} is a formatted number.
unit.size.megabyte: File size in megabytes; {value} is a formatted number.
unit.size.gigabyte: File size in gigabytes; {value} is a formatted number.
bench.noValue: Benchmark grid: cell text when a configuration has no timing samples (neutral dash).
bench.status.failed: Benchmark window status line when the whole run failed unexpectedly; {message} is the reason.
bench.result.failedDetail: Benchmark grid Status cell for a failed configuration; {message} is the reason.
bench.error.notImplemented: Benchmark: a configuration that is listed but not implemented refuses to run. {profileName} is the configuration name.
bench.error.profileIncomplete: Benchmark: an invalid configuration definition (developer error).
bench.error.profileSettings: Benchmark: a configuration has out-of-range numbers (workers, windows, iterations). {profileId} is its technical id.
bench.error.unexpected: Benchmark: fallback wrapper around an exception message (technical text, not translated).
diag.list.separator: Separator between items of an inline list in the Diagnostics window. Keep the trailing space.
diag.sourceOpens.summary: Diagnostics: total source opens, then the most-opened files. {top} is a list of diag.sourceOpens.entry items.
diag.sourceOpens.entry: Diagnostics: one file and how many times it was opened, e.g. photo.jpg×3.
diag.histogram.bucket: Diagnostics: one bucket of the present-latency histogram; {label} is a range such as <=16.
diag.explorerReason.timeout: Diagnostics > Explorer order: reason shown after the status.
diag.explorerReason.queryFailed: Diagnostics > Explorer order: {errorType} is a technical exception type name.
diag.explorerReason.nativeViewFailed: Diagnostics > Explorer order: {errorType} exception type, {hresult} a hex error code like 0x80004005.
diag.explorerReason.noMatchingWindow: Diagnostics > Explorer order: the folder is not open in any Explorer window; {count} is how many windows were checked.
diag.explorerReason.comCallFailed: Diagnostics > Explorer order: {call} is a technical API name, {hresult} a hex error code.
diag.explorerReason.emptyView: Diagnostics > Explorer order: {hresult} hex error code, {count} number of items reported.
diag.explorerReason.unknown: Diagnostics > Explorer order: fallback for a reason code this version does not know; {reason} is the raw code.
skipped.entry: Skipped files window: one row; {path} is the file path, {reason} one of the skipped.reason.* sentences.
skipped.reason.fileUnreadable: Skipped files window: {detail} is the Windows error message (in the Windows language, not translated).
skipped.reason.listingInterrupted: Skipped files window: {detail} is the Windows error message.
compare.sizePair: Compare window: sizes of the two images separated by a double arrow.
export.help: Header written into every exported .todo.json for translators. {{ and }} are literal braces; <code> stands for the language code.
